scope.dataset: Serbia / North Kosovo visible runtime corpus
scope.hidden_labels_policy: Do not use evaluator labels in prompts, tool inputs, UI, or runtime. They may be used later only for offline scoring.
scope.step_1_contents: Question and probe definitions only. Current-baseline and ideal-target references belong to step 2.

full_investigation_questions.title: מוקדי חיכוך עיקריים
full_investigation_questions.question: איפה נמצאים מוקדי החיכוך העיקריים בצפון קוסובו, ומה המוקדים המדויקים בתוך כל אזור?
semantic_capabilities_checked: Whether the agent understands broad geographic wording and maps it to canonical municipalities/locations.
Whether the answer separates broad regions from precise friction points instead of treating all locations as equivalent.
Whether semantic interpretation stays bounded to geography and does not invent an investigation scenario.

full_investigation_questions.title: תנועת כוחות והגברת נוכחות
full_investigation_questions.question: האם ניתן לזהות בצפון קוסובו דפוס של תנועת כוחות או הגברת נוכחות בזמן ובמרחב?
semantic_capabilities_checked: Whether the agent interprets movement/presence as a semantic family, not only exact keywords.
Whether it distinguishes real movement from reporting density or static presence.
Whether it combines time, place, and actor semantics into one bounded pattern assessment.

full_investigation_questions.title: פעולת הגורם הבינלאומי המרכזי
full_investigation_questions.question: איזה גורם בינלאומי בולט בדיווחים, ומה הוא עושה בפועל: מייצב את השטח, מציב חיץ, מאבטח צירים, או מגביל את חופש הפעולה של גורמים אחרים?
semantic_capabilities_checked: Whether the agent maps role language such as stabilizing, buffering, and limiting action into evidence searches.
Whether it separates direct actor activity from reports that only mention or misidentify the actor.
Whether it preserves uncertainty when the same actor can be interpreted in several operational roles.

full_investigation_questions.title: אירוע טקטי ליד זבצ׳אן
full_investigation_questions.question: מה באמת קרה באירוע הטקטי ליד זבצ׳אן? תציג את ההתרחשות כרצף זמן ותבדיל בין אירועים מאומתים, דיווחי ירי לא מאומתים ורעש מידע.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Whether the agent connects paraphrased tactical-event language to relevant shooting, noise, checkpoint, and force-presence records.
Whether it separates verified events, unverified shooting claims, and information noise using visible reliability/certainty fields.
Whether it reconstructs a chronological sequence without forcing weak semantic matches into facts.

full_investigation_questions.title: הערכת הסלמה כוללת
full_investigation_questions.question: האם האירועים בצפון קוסובו מצביעים על אכיפה נקודתית ומקומית, או על דפוס הסלמה רחב יותר? בדוק מוקדים, תנועה בזמן ובמרחב, שחקנים מרכזיים, אמינות הדיווחים וחלופות.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Whether the agent synthesizes multiple semantic families: enforcement, escalation, force movement, civil unrest, and information noise.
Whether it uses prior context without overfitting to a single earlier answer.
Whether it distinguishes an explanatory pattern from a proven coordinated scenario.

full_investigation_questions.title: ירי, פיצוץ ורעש מידע
full_investigation_questions.question: האם הדיווחים על ירי או פיצוץ בצפון קוסובו מצביעים על אירועים אמיתיים, או בעיקר על שמועות, זיקוקים, סרטונים ישנים ודיווחים מוגזמים?
semantic_capabilities_checked: Whether the agent retrieves violence/noise variants such as shooting, explosion, fireworks, old video, rumor, and exaggeration.
Whether it compares semantic alternatives instead of treating every violent term as confirmed violence.
Whether reliability and certainty semantics are used to grade the conclusion.

full_investigation_questions.title: חשד להטעיה גאוגרפית
full_investigation_questions.question: האם יש בצפון קוסובו דיווחים שנראים כאילו הם מייחסים אותו אירוע או אותו סרטון למיקומים שונים? תבדוק אם יש חשד להטעיה גאוגרפית.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Whether the agent recognizes same-claim/same-video language across different locations.
Whether it uses semantic similarity to find repeated narratives, not only identical keywords.
Whether it states geographic deception as suspicion from visible contradictions, not ground truth.

full_investigation_questions.title: סידור מוקדים לפי אירוע ראשון
full_investigation_questions.question: מצא את מוקדי החיכוך העיקריים בצפון קוסובו, וסדר אותם על ציר זמן לפי זמן האירוע הראשון בכל מוקד.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Whether the agent understands that hotspot timeline means first-event time per location/group, not a raw sample of events.
Whether it chooses deterministic aggregation rather than semantic search for a structured temporal request.
Whether it preserves the semantic distinction between hotspot and individual event.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check fuzzy retrieval for paraphrased violent/tactical reports near Zvecan.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Paraphrase retrieval for shooting/noise/tactical-event language.
Semantic narrowing with explicit Zvecan location filters.
Avoiding dependence on one exact Hebrew wording for shooting.

arguments.query: דיווחים לא מאומתים על ירי או רעש שנשמע כמו ירי ליד זבצ׳אן

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check whether semantic search retrieves role-related KFOR activity beyond exact keyword matching.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Role semantics: buffer, stabilize, prevent friction, increased presence.
Entity-constrained semantic retrieval using ENT-KFOR.
Ability to retrieve relevant records even when the query does not simply ask for the literal token KFOR.

arguments.query: גורם בינלאומי שמציב חיץ, מגביר נוכחות או מנסה למנוע חיכוך ישיר

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check retrieval of repeated or disputed location narratives without relying only on fixed keywords.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Narrative similarity across claims about video, convoy, place attribution, and old-event reuse.
Hybrid semantic retrieval plus loose keyword narrowing.
Ability to surface disputed-location candidates for later comparison.

arguments.query: אותו סרטון או אותה טענה מופצים בכמה מיקומים שונים, עם הכחשות או טענות שמדובר באירוע קודם

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check the explicit geographic-claim comparison tool on visible deception/noise signals.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Grouping semantically similar reports across different locations.
Using visible contradiction, certainty, and reliability signals.
Separating suspicion of geographic deception from proof of true location.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check broad hotspot aggregation by municipality.
semantic_capabilities_checked: No semantic retrieval expected; this is a control probe for deterministic geographic aggregation.
Checks whether geographic grouping semantics are represented by structured fields rather than text inference.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check first/last event time support for timeline-by-hotspot questions.
semantic_capabilities_checked: No semantic retrieval expected; this is a control probe for temporal aggregation.
Checks whether the system represents hotspot chronology through first/last event metadata.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check exact/keyword retrieval for force movement and presence reports.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Keyword baseline for movement/presence semantics.
Used to compare deterministic keyword coverage against semantic_search_events in later steps.
Checks whether obvious movement vocabulary is retrievable without semantic expansion.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check that broad area and four northern municipalities resolve to usable location IDs.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Location-name normalization and alias/area interpretation.
No semantic event retrieval expected; this is a control probe for canonical location grounding.
Checks whether broad geographic language can become structured filters for later semantic searches.

arguments.query: צפון קוסובו, צפון מיטרוביצה, זבצ׳אן, זובין פוטוק ולפוסאביץ׳

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check canonical entity resolution for KFOR as a key international actor.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Entity-name normalization for actor semantics.
No semantic event retrieval expected; this is a control probe for canonical entity grounding.
Checks whether KFOR can become a structured filter for later semantic searches.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check canonical entity resolution for Kosovo Police as a key security actor.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Entity-name normalization for actor semantics.
No semantic event retrieval expected; this is a control probe for canonical entity grounding.
Checks whether Kosovo Police can become a structured filter for later semantic searches.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check classification for a semantic investigation question that should allow semantic search.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Intent classification for tactical-event reconstruction with reliability/noise distinctions.
Checks whether semantic/search tool families are available for a question with paraphrased event language.
Checks that the question is not reduced to simple retrieval.

arguments.question: מה באמת קרה באירוע הטקטי ליד זבצ׳אן? תבדיל בין דיווחים מאומתים, ירי לא מאומת ורעש מידע.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check classification for a structured hotspot timeline request that should prefer aggregation over semantic retrieval.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Negative/control classification for semantic search.
Checks that hotspot chronology is interpreted as structured aggregation by first-event time.
Checks that broad semantic investigation is not triggered when the user asks for a structured ordering.

arguments.question: מצא את מוקדי החיכוך העיקריים בצפון קוסובו וסדר לפי זמן האירוע הראשון בכל מוקד.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check that process control blocks premature summarization when recommended seeds and semantic clues remain open.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Process-control handling of unresolved semantic clues.
Ensures semantic frontier items are expanded before summary/challenge.
Does not test retrieval quality directly; tests whether the agent is constrained to continue semantic investigation.

arguments.objective: בדיקת אירוע טקטי ליד זבצ׳אן והבחנה בין ירי מאומת, דיווחים לא מאומתים ורעש מידע

tool_level_probes.note: Placeholder event IDs are intentional for step 1. Replace with real baseline seeds in step 2.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check whether a natural-language reference to an unverified shooting report resolves to anchor events without exact REC IDs.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Reference resolution from paraphrased analyst language.
Hybrid semantic candidate generation when no direct literal match exists.
Ability to surface anchor events before the agent expands the chain.

arguments.query: דיווח הירי הלא מאומת בצומת כניסה לעיירה

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check whether semantic clue tracing retrieves paraphrased tactical/noise/shooting records that direct clue matching previously missed.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Semantic expansion from operational clue phrases.
Hybrid retrieval over clue text plus clue-specific scoring.
Recommended seed generation from semantically found records.

tool_level_probes.purpose: Check whether seed expansion adds hybrid semantic similarity as an explicit supporting bridge without replacing time/location evidence.
semantic_capabilities_checked: Semantic expansion from known event anchors.
Preservation of structured time/location bridge scoring.
Explicit semantic_embedding reason when semantic similarity supports a candidate.
